summary: Stocks are lower at the open after a hotter-than-expected CPI report lifted bond yields and rate-hike bets. Chip stocks are leading the decline while bank earnings roll in.
market_note: Futures and indexes soft; 10-year yields surging on the CPI surprise, Fed beige book on deck this afternoon.

items.why: Chip stocks are falling across the tape: memory-chip names are extending declines and ASML is down, and AMD is the steepest decliner on the watchlist.
Slipping with the broader risk-off tape after hot CPI data; eyes turn to Thursday evening's rescheduled Roadster livestream event.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as mega-caps sell off on rate-hike bets after the hot inflation report.
Down with the chip sector, which Yahoo Finance flagged as falling at the open alongside memory-chip stocks extending their declines.
